evaluation_basis: Assessed as a frozen forward-data collector following the spent v0.12 holdout; descriptive collection cannot establish alpha.
original_objective: Open a new post-v0.12 BTC/ETH microstructure window with synchronized 1h spot/perpetual basis, taker-flow and conservatively available OI.

engineering_result.summary: Checksum/schema, synchronized basis, separate spot/futures taker-flow and conservative OI availability contracts were defined; liquidation history was explicitly DATA_UNAVAILABLE.

scientific_result.summary: Only coverage and diagnostic Spearman correlations were authorized; no model promotion or BUY/SELL decision was permitted.

economic_result.summary: No minimum-window alpha evaluation or profitability claim belonged to v0.13.

contribution_to_next_version: Created a genuinely new evidence window and prevented retuning of the spent v0.12 holdout.
